changes: Closed two connected ClawCreek dead-ends. (1) New audited verification_intent_repair (mode=fromEvidence): reconstructs ONLY missing verificationIntent lanes from existing passing evidence — priority=should (never weaponizes the coverage gate), never overwrites authored intent, fail-closed on malformed refs, refused in INIT/INIT_CHECK/terminal. (2) story_review + validate name the repair path via a shared detectLegacyEvidenceWithoutIntent helper while keeping missing-intent a hard blocker (hint is additive, never a pass condition). (3) INIT_CHECK worktree bootstrap honors a configured gitRoot via the shared signed-workspace resolver (storyRel re-anchored + realpath-canonicalized), fails closed on an unusable gitRoot, plain repos unchanged.
usage: Run `lattice verification_intent_repair --storyId=<id> --mode=fromEvidence --legacyRepair=true --reason="…(>=30 chars)…"` (add --dryRun to preview) on a mid-flight story whose checklist has passing verificationEvidence but no verificationIntent. story_review/validate now show the repair command when that legacy state exists. Wrapper-root projects set lattice.config.json gitRoot to a subdir and storyDir inside it; story_advance INIT_CHECK then bootstraps the worktree in the real repo.
expectedOutcome: Legacy stories with evidence-but-no-intent can be repaired with one auditable command instead of hand-editing JSON; wrapper-root projects with a configured gitRoot can enter INIT_CHECK without manual worktree creation; invalid gitRoot fails closed with a clear reason.
actualTranscript: verification_intent_repair runs on B-4e06 (preflight + phase guard + owner-lease gate enforced); 11/11 repair smoke; verify-init-check-bootstrap all (incl. nested-gitroot success + invalid-gitroot fail-closed); verify-story-review-structured-output all incl. legacy-evidence-no-intent integration (story_review repairCommand + validate legacyEvidenceWithoutIntent, blocker preserved); validate 23/23 covered. See evidence/transcript-diff.md.
outcomeDiff: No diff — every scenario matched the PLAN expectation.
limitations: Wrapper-root layout requires story metadata to live INSIDE the configured gitRoot (storyDir under gitRoot); metadata outside the gitRoot fails closed by design. sourceManifestDigest help issue (incident Problem 3) was out of scope and did not reproduce (guarded by the help-health smoke).
pitfalls: Do NOT synthesize 'must' intents — only 'should' — or a repair could retroactively fail a previously-passing story's coverage gate. The realpath canonicalization on both storyRel sides is required on macOS (/var vs /private/var) or the scoped bootstrap git add fails with an opaque 'outside repository' error.
